description:
This header file defines the interface for the RdkEasyMeshController onboarding handler, including initialization, onboarding procedures for agents and radios, status checks, and topology discovery control in the context of OpenWRT or similar embedded systems.
It contains function declarations, constants, and include directives relevant to the onboarding process within the Ethernet/mesh management components.

methods.name: map_onboarding_handler_init
methods.description: Initializes the onboarding handler, setting up necessary data structures and state.

methods.name: map_onboarding_handler_fini
methods.description: Deinitializes the onboarding handler, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: map_handle_new_agent_onboarding
methods.description: Prepares the controller for onboarding a new agent, creating structures and initiating topology queries.

methods.name: map_handle_new_radio_onboarding
methods.description: Prepares for onboarding a new radio, creating data model nodes and initiating policy configuration.

methods.name: map_is_agent_onboarded
methods.description: Checks whether the specified agent has completed onboarding.

methods.name: map_is_all_radio_M1_received
methods.description: Verifies if all radios have received the M1 message.

methods.name: map_is_all_radio_configured
methods.description: Checks if all radios are fully configured after onboarding.

methods.name: map_is_channel_selection_enabled
methods.description: Determines if channel selection is enabled in UCI configuration.

methods.name: map_get_dead_agent_detection_interval
methods.description: Retrieves the dead agent detection interval from UCI.

methods.name: map_get_topology_query_retry_interval_sec
methods.description: Retrieves the topology query retry interval in seconds.

methods.name: map_restart_topology_discovery
methods.description: Restarts topology discovery on the specified interface.

methods.name: map_stop_topology_discovery
methods.description: Stops topology discovery on the specified interface.
